register.labelZh: SHOOT 片語動詞的實際用途
register.summaryZh: shoot for something 可以自然地表達某人希望取得的結果、分數或名次。；shoot off 和 shoot through 可以描述迅速離開;shoot up 則可以描述價格、數字或水平急升。；shoot down、shoot something off 和 shoot something up 常見於涉及槍擊的報道和故事。；shoot up 可以表示急升或槍擊;shoot off 和 shoot through 都與離開有關,但一般用於不同情境。────────────────────────
register.summaryEn: Shoot for something lets you talk naturally about the result, score or position that someone hopes to achieve. Shoot off and shoot through describe people leaving quickly, while shoot up describes prices, numbers or levels rising very fast. Shoot down, shoot something off and shoot something up often appear in reports and stories involving gunfire. Shoot up may describe a sudden increase or an armed attack. Shoot off and shoot through both involve leaving, but they are normally used in different situations.
